question.text: An independent valuer for a Cat II AIF must NOT be an associate of which of the following?

answer.text: The Manager, Sponsor, or Trustee of the AIF

explanation.text: The Logic: Per PDF Section 11.12: 'The independent valuer shall not be an associate of manager or sponsor or trustee of the AIF.' The independence net covers all three parties — M, S, T. The Trap: Single-party options miss the full disqualification perimeter; the statutory auditor is not explicitly in the SEBI valuer-associate list (though practical independence from audit function is also good governance). The three named parties are M/S/T. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests same rule. XIX-A tests it from an LP perspective. Compare to Companies Act Sec 144 (auditor independence), which is a related-party net. Manager's Pro-Tip: Run a related-party matrix at valuer onboarding: check if valuer's parent/subsidiary/JV has any engagement with the Manager, Sponsor, or Trustee. Even group-level relationships can trigger associate status and disqualify the valuer.
